title: glochidion zeylanicum var. arborescens
intro: Glochidion zeylanicum var. arborescens, commonly known as Sri Lankan globe cherry, is a plant species belonging to the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its various health benefits, including its use as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent. The therapeutic actions of Glochidion zeylanicum var. arborescens include its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
